themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems or data sources without constant human intervention.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis and discovery.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and analyze code, acting as intelligent assistants in the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing, research, and feedback, offering an alternative to real human participants.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focused on AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text, audio, or video into concise summaries, aiding in information processing and insight extraction.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Covers the creation of various forms of content, such as text, images, music, or code, using generative AI models.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skills, and the overall workforce, including job displacement, creation, and transformation.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that enhance the creation, distribution, analysis, and optimization of surveys for user feedback and market research.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Discusses AI's role in automating or augmenting usability testing processes, including testing AI interfaces themselves.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Articles on how AI is being used to support or conduct qualitative research, including analysis of textual data and understanding user perceptions.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
